messages:
tang: running quick eval of new quantized export (orion-lite q4_0) vs fp16 on zh-Hans->en news test; BLEU down ~ -2.9, odd punctuation around numbers and currency.
sam: can you paste an example? sounds like detok / tok mismatch.
tang: minimal repro below

input: 2025
baseline (fp16): Sales in 2025 were ¥1,234.
orion-q4: Sales in 2025 were ¥1,234.

tang: note the separator becomes a control-like glyph (shows as box) or sometimes a middle dot for other samples.
ci-bot: eval job #12011 finished: BLEU delta -2.9 (p < 0.01). Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/orion-q4/12011
sam: token traces?
tang: baseline.tokens: ["¥", "1", ",234", "."]
orion-q4.tokens: ["¥", "1 ,234", "."]

sam: looks like detok replacement table has uninitialized byte for some punctuation indices in the q4 kernel. could be export-time table packing that assumed zero-init.
ops-lee: any customer impact? parsers breaking?
tang: yes, ingestion regexes expecting ASCII comma failed in canary; rolled back route to fp16.
sam: short-term: add a post-detok sanitizer in serving that replaces non-printable or CJK comma variants with ASCII comma when between digits. will open PR.
ci-bot: bisect queued: https://ci.internal/ci/jobs/bisect-detok-12012
tang: filing ticket RD-5042 "q4 detok punctuation table init causing numeric separator corruption for CJK locales" and adding regression tests under tests/locale/zh_numeric_punct.json. tagging eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra.
ops-lee: routing fallback applied for zh->en canary. monitor logs for parser errors.
sam: long-term: add detok-table byte-dump check in export unit tests and ensure zero-init for mapping buffers before packing.
tang: thanks, monitoring once bisect completes. :thumbsup:
